_: What this repository's gate reads and builds. The gate is verify.ps1, a pass-through to run.ps1. No census of what its stages open has been taken (the suite reads proofs.json, proofs/modules.json and every model's text; the proof leg reads every file under proofs/ and the two Fable test directories), so `reads` claims every tracked file (`**`): nothing is gate-inert. `builds` names what the gate builds: the solution (the kernel, the runtime, the session log, the testing library, the React adapter, the browser package, the five test projects and the oracle project the prover generates), and the three projects the gate also transpiles with Fable (two of them run under Node). `notBuilt` names the project files it deliberately does not build, with the reason. Revised in Phase 646, the phase that added the first project, and in Phase 647, which added the runtime and the testing library, and in Phase 649, which added the session log (`Fuaran.MVU.Session`, built by the solution and compiled from its sources into the Node test project), and in Phase 720, which added the React adapter (`Fuaran.MVU.React`, built by the solution and transpiled with Fable in Release and in Debug for the hot-reload check) and its laws (`tests/Fuaran.MVU.React.Tests`, built by the solution, run on .NET, built once more with `-p:FuaranMvuNegative=governed` where the build must fail, and transpiled with Fable and run under Node), and in Phase 719, which added the browser package (`Fuaran.MVU.Browser`, built by the solution and transpiled with Fable as a dependency of its laws) and its laws (`tests/Fuaran.MVU.Browser.Tests`, built by the solution, run on .NET, and transpiled with Fable and run under Node).
